items.title: 【开源自荐】zshrc：一个极简 macOS App，只做一件事，打开查看、编辑 ~/.zshrc
items.author: iHongRen
items.summary: zshrc zshrc 一个极简开源的 macOS App，打开就能查看、编辑 ~/.zshrc。
items.content: # zshrc [zshrc](https://github.com/iHongRen/zshrc) 一个极简开源的 macOS App，打开就能查看、编辑 `~/.zshrc`。 ### 安装 1、推荐使用安装脚本： ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iHongRen/zshrc/main/install.sh | sh ``` 默认会安装到 `/Applications/zshrc.app`。 2、手动安装： 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/iHongRen/zshrc/releases) 下载最新的 `zshrc.dmg` 后安装。终端执行命令，去除未签名应用的隔离属性： ```sh xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/zshrc.app ``` ### 功能特性 - 直接编辑 `~/.zshrc` - 行号显示与 Shell 语法高亮 - 搜索栏、结果计数、上一个/下一个匹配跳转 - 保存时执行语法检查 - 显示保存状态、语法状态、光标行列号 - 支持放大、缩小、恢复默认字号 - 支持浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统 - 支持英文 / 简体中文界面 - 可以在 Finder 中定位 `.zshrc`

items.title: 【工具自荐】Selector：点一下网页元素，复制给 AI 编程助手的精准上下文
items.author: oil-oil
items.summary: 项目地址： GitHub： 最近一直在用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类 AI 编程助手改页面，发现一个小问题：截图很直观，但经常缺少 DOM / React 上下文；直接复制 HTML 又太长，AI 容易被无关信息带偏。 所以做了 Selector，一个很小的 bookmarklet。拖到书签栏后，在任意页面点选元素，就可以复制一段比较干净的上下文 prompt，包含页面路径、稳定 locator、可见文本、React 组件路径（如果能识别到），以及少量样式和布局信息。目标很简单：让 AI 编程助手更快理解“我要改的是这个具体元素”。 它没有做成浏览器插件，也没有账号、后端和聊天界面。只是一个很轻的工具，适合在 localhost、React / Next.js 项目或线上页面上临时使用。 我自己主要拿它辅助 Vibe coding：选中按钮、卡片、表格单元格这类 UI 后，复制给 AI，让它少猜一点上下文。项目完全开源，希望对也在用 AI coding agents 改界面的同学有帮助。 !Selector screenshot
items.content:
项目地址：https://oil-oil.github.io/selector/

GitHub：https://github.com/oil-oil/selector

最近一直在用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类 AI 编程助手改页面，发现一个小问题：截图很直观，但经常缺少 DOM / React 上下文；直接复制 HTML 又太长，AI 容易被无关信息带偏。

所以做了 Selector，一个很小的 bookmarklet。拖到书签栏后，在任意页面点选元素，就可以复制一段比较干净的上下文 prompt，包含页面路径、稳定 locator、可见文本、React 组件路径（如果能识别到），以及少量样式和布局信息。目标很简单：让 AI 编程助手更快理解“我要改的是这个具体元素”。

它没有做成浏览器插件，也没有账号、后端和聊天界面。只是一个很轻的工具，适合在 localhost、React / Next.js 项目或线上页面上临时使用。

我自己主要拿它辅助 Vibe coding：选中按钮、卡片、表格单元格这类 UI 后，复制给 AI，让它少猜一点上下文。项目完全开源，希望对也在用 AI coding agents 改界面的同学有帮助。

![Selector screenshot](https://ph-files.imgix.net/90f32834-a664-4344-b7b3-e6002e192d90.png?auto=compress,format&codec=mozjpeg&cs=strip&fit=max&w=1270)

items.title: 【工具自荐】PixSolo - 一款极简高效的应用商店截图在线设计工具
items.author: cena001plus
items.summary: 1.介绍 PixSolo 是一款专为独立开发者和移动研发团队打造的「应用商店截图预览图」在线设计工具。 开发者在提交 App Store 或 Google Play 上架时，往往需要花费大量时间用设计软件拼接带壳宣传图。PixSolo 将这一过程“工作流化”，用户只需按步骤上传截图、选择机型和背景、输入介绍文案，即可在几分钟内快速导出符合官方规范的高级感营销截图。 2.核心特性 向导式设计工作流：摒弃了传统设计软件复杂的“图层”概念，采用线性向导推进，零设计基础的程序员也能无脑上手。 海量主流机型套壳：内置了 iPhone、Samsung、Xiaomi、Huawei、Google Pixel 等各大品牌旗舰机型的超清边框素材。 支持自定义手机框：除内置素材外，支持开发者上传自己定制的 PNG 机型边框。 AI 驱动背景生成：内置 GPT Image 2、Nano Banana 2 / Pro 等图像生成模型，可通过 Prompt 一键生成独一无二的艺术背景。 丰富的预设样式：内置 30 种不同视觉风格的背景设计样式（如渐变、毛玻璃、极简几何等）。 开箱即用的模板库：提供大量参考了优秀商业 App 截图的成熟排版模板，支持一键套用。

items.title: 【开源自荐】妙幕：本地媒体创作工作台，支持六大 ASR 模型的音视频字幕生成、翻译、校对、烧录工具
items.author: buxuku
items.summary: 项目地址： 妙幕（SmartSub）是一款本地优先的桌面应用，帮你一站式完成「音视频转字幕 → 翻译 → 校对 → 合成」。所有转写都在本地完成，无需上传文件，隐私无忧；支持批量处理与 GPU 加速，可在 Windows / macOS / Linux 上运行。
items.content: #### 项目地址： https://github.com/buxuku/SmartSub 妙幕（SmartSub）是一款本地优先的桌面应用，帮你**一站式**完成「音视频转字幕 → 翻译 → 校对 → 合成」。所有转写都在本地完成，无需上传文件，隐私无忧；支持批量处理与 GPU 加速，可在 Windows / macOS / Linux 上运行。 ## ✨ 核心看点 - **🧠 多转写引擎**：**6 种可逐任务切换的引擎**——内置 `whisper.cpp`、`faster-whisper`、`FunASR`、`Qwen3-ASR`、`FireRedASR`、以及本地 `Whisper CLI`。中文场景可直接选用 FunASR / FireRedASR 等专长模型。 - **⚡ GPU 加速全面支持**：支持 **Vulkan** 后端，**AMD / Intel 显卡**也能在 Windows/Linux 上加速，Nvida 显卡也支持 NVIDIA CUDA； - **🎬 视频合成（字幕烧录）**：把字幕**硬烧**进画面，或**软封装**为可切换字幕轨；所见即所得预览，支持字体、字号、颜色、描边、阴影、九宫格位置与多种预设样式。 - **📝 字幕校对 + AI 润色**：内置校对台，逐句对照视频检查修改，支持撤销/重做与 AI 一键润色。 - **🌐 17 个翻译服务**：覆盖主流机器翻译与大模型 API，并支持 OpenAI 风格自定义接入 ## 💥 功能特性 ### 🧠 字幕生成（转写） - 支持多种视频/音频格式批量生成字幕 - **6 种转写引擎**，可针对每个任务单独选择 - 完全本地处理，无需联网上传，保护隐私的同时拥有更快的速度 - 支持简繁转换、自定义字幕文件名（方便不同播放器挂载识别） - 可选**中文字幕去标点**，让烧录效果更干净 - 支持自定义并发任务数量，批量处理更高效 ### 🌐 字幕翻译 - 对生成的字幕或导入的字幕进行翻译 - **17 个翻译服务**：百度、谷歌、阿里云、火山引擎、豆包、小牛、腾讯、讯飞、DeepLX、Azure、Ollama（本地模型）、DeepSeek、Azure OpenAI、Gemini、SiliconFlow、通义千问等 - 兼容任意 **OpenAI 风格 API**，可接入 deepseek / azure 等自有服务 - 输出内容可选纯译文，或「原文 + 译文」双语字幕 - **🎯 自定义参数配置**：无需改代码，直接在界面为每个 AI 服务配置请求头/请求体参数，并支持导出导入 ### 📝 字幕校对 - 内置校对台，逐句检查与修改 - 视频对照预览，定位更准 - 支持撤销/重做与 **AI 一键润色** ### 🎬 视频合成 - **硬字幕烧录**：把字幕永久烧进画面，任何播放器都能显示 - **软字幕封装**：以流复制方式无损嵌入可切换字幕轨 - 丰富的样式控制：字体、字号、颜色、描边、阴影、九宫格位置，以及多种预设样式 - 所见即所得实时预览 ### ⚡ 隐私与加速 - 本地化处理，文件不出本机 - GPU 加速：NVIDIA CUDA、AMD/Intel Vulkan、Apple Core ML / Metal - 内置加速包管理，无需手动安装 CUDA Toolkit ## 📸 界面一览 | 视频合成（字幕烧录） | 字幕校对 | | --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | | ![merge](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a82d2f66-40f4-461b-a1e3-fe167b0d5ab6) | ![proofread](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/81a45592-1e50-4297-8a4a-5c752efaf196) |

items.author: tianrking
items.summary: 大家好，我做了一个开源项目 EdgeMirror， 项目地址： 在线体验：
items.content: 大家好，我做了一个开源项目 **EdgeMirror**， 项目地址：https://github.com/tianrking/EdgeMirror 在线体验：https://box.w0x7ce.eu EdgeMirror 是一个一站式开发资源加速网关，可以把常见的开发者源站统一接入到一个边缘代理入口中，用来加速包安装、模型下载、代码克隆、镜像拉取和各类文件下载。 它主要可以做这些事情： - 加速 Python 包安装：PyPI、Python wheel、PyTorch wheel - 加速 AI 模型下载：Hugging Face 模型、数据集、LFS 大文件 - 加速 GitHub 资源：`git clone`、raw 文件、release assets、GitHub Pages - 加速 Docker 镜像拉取：Docker Hub、GHCR、GCR、Quay、K8s、NVCR - 加速 Linux 软件源：APT、YUM、DNF、Pacman、wget、curl 镜像路径 - 加速前端包安装：npm、pnpm、yarn registry - 加速 Go 依赖下载：兼容 GOPROXY - 加速 Java 依赖下载：Maven Central、Google Maven、Gradle Plugin Portal、JitPack - 加速 Rust crate 下载：crates.io sparse registry 和 `.crate` 包 - 加速运行时和工具下载：Node.js、Python、Go、Rustup、Open VSX、SourceForge、GitLab、Gitea - 加速任意公开文件链接：通过通用 HTTP/HTTPS 文件代理下载 简单来说，它把平时分散配置的各种开发源加速，收敛成一个统一入口。 ## 使用示例 # 在线下载 # 加速 PyPI pip install numpy -i https://edgemirror.w0x7ce.eu/pypi/simple/ # 加速 Hugging Face export HF_ENDPOINT=https://edgemirror.w0x7ce.eu/hf huggingface-cli download gpt2 # 加速 GitHub clone git clone https://edgemirror.w0x7ce.eu/github/vercel/next.js.git # 加速 Docker pull docker pull edgemirror.w0x7ce.eu/library/nginx:latest # 加速 npm npm install lodash --registry=https://edgemirror.w0x7ce.eu/npm/

items.title: Rosply
items.summary: AI agent that controls your computer autonomously
items.content: Rosply is an AI agent that sees your screen and controls your computer. It moves the mouse, types, clicks, and completes real tasks autonomously on Windows, Mac, and Linux. It works with any vision capable, intelligent model via OpenRouter, so you are never locked into one provider. Native Claude Code and MCP integration lets developers plug it into their workflow as an agent that executes tasks, not just writes code.

items.title: Jotform AI App Builder
items.summary: Turn ideas into powerful apps within seconds
items.content: Build complete apps by describing what you need. Jotform AI App Builder generates pages, forms, workflows, and data management automatically, then lets you refine everything with AI or manual edits. If you need something more advanced, AI can automatically generate custom widgets for dashboards, charts, calculators, and interactive tools, or let you create your own with AI Widget Creator. Combine forms, tables, AI agents, and custom widgets in a single app.

items.title: Sipcode
items.summary: Keep Claude Code's context clean for sharper answers
items.content: Context hygiene for Claude Code. Caps verbose tool output and dedupes same-session re-reads so the model sees signal, not noise. Anthropic measures 29% quality lift from cleaner context. Proof: 62.6% median tool-output savings on a locked 20-task benchmark. MIT.

items.title: LyfAgentOS
items.summary: Manage leads, follow-ups, calls and policies in one place
items.content: LyfAgentOS is a CRM built specifically for life insurance agents. Manage leads, follow-ups, appointments, calling workflows, licenses, carriers, and policy sales from a single platform. Features include lead management, power call mode, follow-up tracking, Google Calendar integration, skip tracing, carrier management, licensing tools, and performance dashboards. Built to replace spreadsheets and generic CRMs with a workflow designed for the way insurance agents actually work.

items.title: Drama 15-Chapter Drama Novel Assistant
items.summary: From logline to Chapter 15, with craft built in
items.content: Most AI writing tools give you a wall of text and wish you luck. Drama15 is built for one job: commercial short drama in exactly 15 chapters — the format readers binge and platforms love. You start with a seed idea. The studio helps you shape a concept, story bible, relationship map, and chapter-by-chapter plan. Then it drafts each chapter against a fixed drama arc: hook, escalation, foreshadow, nadir, public reveal — not random “continue the story.”

items.title: Bloom AI
items.summary: AI sales coach for better B2B calls
items.content: Bloom IA helps B2B sales teams turn every call into actionable coaching insights. It combines VoIP calls, messaging, call analysis and AI feedback so managers can spot what reps need to improve: discovery, objections, closing, follow-up and communication. Built for teams that want better sales execution, not just more activity.

items.title: Knowable
items.summary: The World's First Visual AI Tutor
items.content: Knowable coaches you blockers by analyzing your notebook and your problem solving process in real time as you work your way through problem sets

items.title: PicFlow
items.summary: AI product photos for Shopify sellers. No studio.
items.content: PicFlow turns any smartphone product photo into professional e-commerce images. Upload one photo → AI removes background → generates lifestyle scenes → auto-resizes for Amazon, Shopify, Etsy. No studio. No Photoshop. No credit systems. First 3 images free. Then $29.90/month unlimited.

items.title: Autoshorts
items.summary: Turn long videos into viral shorts with AI
items.content: AutoShorts is an AI-powered desktop app that turns long-form videos into YouTube Shorts, TikToks, and Reels in minutes. Upload a video, let AI find the best moments, generate clips, add captions, and export ready-to-post content. Built with Tauri and Rust, AutoShorts is fast, private, and local-first.

items.title: AI Readiness Kit
items.summary: The 17 files that make your site understandable to AI
items.content: People now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity before visiting websites. Without clear signals, AI systems guess who you are, what you do, and who to recommend. AI Readiness Kit generates 17 AI-ready files for your website, including llms.txt, ai.txt, schema, RAG indexes, AI sitemaps, and more. Tailored to your industry, generated in minutes. Free and open source (MIT). Use npx or connect through MCP. Built by Silverback Marketing.

items.title: BudgetZen
items.summary: The world's most private AI-powered budgeting app
items.content: A beautiful, privacy-first personal finance app that works 100% offline. Powered by on-device AI for daily insights, Zero-Based Budget Mode, Classic Budget Mode, Zen Score & 20 badges, smart bank CSV import, Project simulator, Weekly coach notifications, Advanced charts, 60+ currencies & 10 languages. No account, no cloud, no data tracking. Your financial data stays yours.

items.title: GenSpend
items.summary: AI Image, Video & Audio Cost Tracker
items.content: GenSpend automatically tracks your AI-generation spending across tools like Magnific, Higgsfield, Veo and ElevenLabs, and many others converting every credit system into real dollars. See the true cost of every finished deliverable, not just per generation. Built for creators and studios who need to know what their AI work actually costs.

items.title: AIFlow Motion
items.summary: Turn AI workflows into animated diagrams
items.content: Design animated AI-workflow diagrams in your browser — RAG pipelines, agent loops, and data flows — then export them as PNG / SVG / GIF / MP4.

items.title: Debate Core
items.summary: Two AI Agents. One Topic. No Holds Barred.
items.content: DebateCore AI pits two AI agents against each other in structured debates on any topic — from business strategy to philosophy. See every side of every argument.

items.title: CoalaCoaching
items.summary: AI session analysis for ICF coach training students
items.content: CoalaCoaching does session transcription and ICF Core Competency analysis for coaches in accredited training programs. No subscription, no per-minute billing, no time caps on transcription length, and the first session is free. Upload a session, get a full transcript, and get it scored against the ICF Core Competencies with specific, actionable points for your next mentoring hour. Track the same metrics across sessions so improvement becomes a number, not just a feeling.

items.title: Ullbek
items.summary: Website Coding Agent
items.content: Ullbek - Website Coding Agent turns plain language into a real website — live, in real HTML, CSS & JS. No templates, no drag and drop, real code! Watch the website come to life in realtime, live! Want a website? Just say it.

items.title: NEXUS AIOS
items.summary: Private, Offline AI-no cloud, no subscriptions, just for you
items.content: "NEXUS AIOS — local-first AI tools. No cloud, no subscriptions, no tracking. Everything runs on your machine. • ORIGO — offline AI workspace with multiple AI personalities • IPSUM — 90 on-device marketing scripts • More tools coming, including The Back Room • Meet the Three Amigos — AI personalities that actually feel like a team, not a tool. Built in the UK. One-time payment. The website? Built on a free builder. Just because we can."

items.title: Truvem
items.summary: Persistent memory for AI agents. Two API calls. Any model.
items.content: Truvem is the memory infrastructure layer for AI agents. Two API calls. Any model. Persistent.

items.title: Sidekick by Growth Magic
items.summary: You know what to do. Sidekick makes you do it.
items.content: Sidekick is an AI accountability coach for high performers who know exactly what to do but aren't doing it. Build with the NO BS philosophy. Pick a coach, set a goal, and get daily check-ins that hold you to your word, not hype. Free to start; voice mode and shareable cards on Premium.

items.title: SensIa
items.summary: IoT supervision + 3D BIM digital twin for buildings
items.content: SensIa is a French SaaS for IoT building supervision. Connect your LoRaWAN or Zigbee sensors in minutes, see them on a live map and a 3D BIM digital twin, fire ISA-18.2-compliant alarms, and get a built-in EU AI Act compliance panel. AI runs on Qwen3 hosted in France. Free plan; Starter EUR 49/mo; Pro EUR 149/mo. Built for facility managers, social landlords and engineering firms looking for an honest alternative to legacy BMS.
